answer.text: There is no separate bulb to buy: the license plate illuminator is an LED unit, and it is listed as 12 V - LED.

The manual says the tail lamp/trafficator and license plate illuminator have an LED lighting system, and if it fails the entire tail lamp/trafficator and license plate illuminator assembly should be replaced.
For the replacement, contact a Royal Enfield Authorised Dealer/Service Centre.

watchouts.text: Make sure the ignition switch is in the OFF position when replacing bulbs, fuses and electrical parts.
